summary: @kevinmarks Love that metaphor? Making them all predators to boot is a little loaded (we can avoid the salt water vs river fish for a bit). What does it mean when the pirhana needs the white shark for sign on and advertising? And does this make the #indieweb a dolphin which can do some damage to sharks?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@kevinmarks Love that metaphor? Making them all predators to boot is a little loaded (we can avoid the salt water vs river fish for a bit). What does it mean when the pirhana needs the white shark for sign on and advertising?

And does this make the #indieweb a dolphin which can do some damage to sharks?
